To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
under conditions of high environmental uncertainty, sophisticated MAS will have a positive effect on small business performance but under low uncertainty it will have a negative effect.
the effects of sophisticated management accounting systems on performance are dependent on the level of perceived environmental uncertainty.
the effects of management accounting system on small business managers performance are dependent on perceived environmental uncertainty.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the management accounting systems of small manufacturing firms and the performance of the firm.
the interaction between management accounting systems and perceived environmental uncertainty in small business firms.
the relationship between the management accounting system and the environment in which the business operates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

MAS are not a panacea for small business management, but that their use is dependent upon environmental uncertainty and that they can be an important source of competitive advantage in certain circumstances.
the effects of sophisticated MAS on small business performance are dependent on environmental uncertainty and the extent to which managers use MAS to control the firm.
the more sophisticated MAS were more effective in a high uncertainty environment, and the less sophisticated MAS were more appropriate in a low uncertainty environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of management accounting system sophistication on small business managers performance are moderated by the perceived environmental uncertainty of the firm.
the results suggest that the relationship between MAS and performance is complex and is dependent on the environmental conditions in which the firm operates.
the results obtained in our study are consistent with those obtained in other studies that have investigated the effects of MAS and environmental uncertainty on managers' perceptions of performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of MAS should be carefully tailored to the needs of the firm, depending upon the degree of environmental uncertainty.

the use of sophisticated MAS in a small business context should be approached with caution, and that managers should consider their level of perceived environmental uncertainty before deciding which MAS to implement.
small business owners should be aware of the impact that environmental uncertainty has on the effectiveness of their management accounting systems.
